pages.text: Ever had a large area of fluid you need cleared up? Well the Mechanized Sponge can do this for you, it just needs a little bit of energy (FE) to get the job done. It can clear up to a 97x97 area. As well as the Mechanized Sponge you are going to need 5 additional Sponge blocks.
pages.title: Mechanized Sponge

pages.text: Place a sponge in each of the 5 directions away from the central mechanized sponge (east, west, south, north and up, up to 47 blocks away; wet sponges work too); they set the area it clears. Then supply it with enough energy: 40 FE for each block of the area. Look at the mechanized sponge to see how much it needs.
